shared_elements: schematic human or anthropomorphic figure/body parts
justification: The main shared content is only broad: both include schematic carved imagery with anthropomorphic/body elements and some round or circular forms. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a single frontal human-like figure with torso, face/body details and bands, while B is a field of separate profile animals/creatures and signs with no comparable frontal body scheme or internal arrangement.
